This post is from the blog I kept as Preceptor in Mathematics at Harvard (2005–2008). It's kept here as an archive; some links are dead and references are dated.

Some of my [Math 21a](http://www.courses.fas.harvard.edu/6760){target="_blank"} students were asking about the Mathematica features I used in class, such as plotting two surfaces on the same axes, or rotating graphics. Here’s [the notebook from March 8’s class](/files/Lesson13_-_Linear_Approximation.nb). Hope it helps. I’ll try to do this more often if there’s interest.
